task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, ensure that the antique trunk is open. After that, pick up the old key from the antique trunk inside the bedroom. After that, make absolutely sure that the wooden door is unlocked. Then, open the wooden door. After that, move east. After that, venture south. Then, retrieve the half of a bag of chips from the couch within the living room. And then, venture north. That done, sit the half of a bag of chips on the stove. And once you've done that, you win!
